K1.IN4 → D13 (GPIO13). K1.IN5 → D23 (GPIO23). K1.IN6 → D19 (GPIO19). K1.IN7 → D18 (GPIO18). K1.IN8 → TX2 (GPIO17).
Odd and even relays take turns switching on (active low): passes
